parameters.content:
## Archive and complete
Route valid invoices, upload missing PDFs over SFTP and upsert the provider register. Confirm each attachment before moving a message to Gmail Trash. Any review attachment retains the entire source message.

## Extract and validate
Read PDF text and apply the four fictional provider profiles. Validate required invoice fields and supported total checks. Unreadable or invalid documents enter **Review Queue**. Adapt the rules to your own PDF layouts.

## Collect invoice PDFs
Search the last **30 days** for matching PDF attachments, including read messages. Exclude unrelated messages by narrowing the query. Split eligible PDFs into linked items and reject files over 20 MiB.

## Start
Run manually or every **15 minutes** after setup. Keep the workflow inactive while configuring credentials and testing invoice samples. Avoid overlapping runs.

# Archive invoice PDFs with SFTP

### Quick overview
Save invoice PDFs from Gmail to SFTP and record them in Google Sheets. Check registered files before uploading, send invalid documents to a Review Queue, and trash emails only after all eligible PDFs are complete.

### How it works
- Fetch matching Gmail PDFs and process one at a time.
- Extract invoice fields with four configurable provider profiles.
- Check Sheets and SFTP; upload missing PDFs and update the register.
- Log rejected documents. Trash a message only when all its PDFs are archived or verified duplicates.

### Setup
- Connect Gmail, SFTP and Sheets credentials.
- Set the spreadsheet ID in all six Sheets nodes.
- Create Utilities, Internet, Cloud, Hosting and Review Queue tabs with the README headers.
- Adapt profile rules and `/invoices/` folders in **Parse invoice and canonical name**.
- Narrow the Gmail query and test each outcome before activation.

### Requirements
Text-based PDFs up to 20 MiB, SFTP access and a writable Google spreadsheet.

### Customization
Change provider patterns, folders, worksheet mappings or the 15-minute schedule. The sample query searches 30 days.

### Notes
No OCR or AI service is included. Avoid overlapping runs. Review messages stay in Gmail; service failures stop the run.

Match invoice number, date and total in Sheets, then check the SFTP filename and byte size. Skip verified duplicates and upload missing files. Upsert rejected or conflicting documents in **Review Queue**; their messages remain in Gmail.
